stateDiagram-v2
  direction LR
  [*] --> Placed
  Placed --> Paid : payment received
  Placed --> Cancelled : customer cancels
  Paid --> Fulfilment
  state Fulfilment {
    [*] --> Packing
    Packing --> Shipped : handed to courier
    Shipped --> [*]
  }
  Fulfilment --> Delivered : courier confirms
  Delivered --> [*]
  Cancelled --> [*]
  note right of Paid
    Payment can be card,
    wallet, or bank transfer
  end note
